key_stat: UK government savings bank | ~£230B deposits | Premium Bonds | Atos managed service
summary: National Savings & Investments (NS&I) is HM Treasury's savings bank. ~£230B deposits from 25M+ customers. Products: Premium Bonds, Income Bonds, Green Savings Bonds. Technology managed by Atos under long-term contract. Major IT transformation needed. Service issues in recent years. Green finance products growing.
